newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chief aide Chubais meets Yeltsin in clinic - agency.
newsitem.headline: Chief aide Chubais meets Yeltsin in clinic - agency.

text.p: Kremlin chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais met Boris Yeltsin for more than half an hour on Tuesday at the Moscow hospital where the president is being treated for pneumonia, Interfax news agency said, quoting unnamed sources.
A Kremlin administration official declined to comment on the report, which said the two men discussed regional elections, personnel matters and other issues of state.
Earlier in the day, the Kremlin press office said Yeltsin's doctors would meet at 5 p.m. (1400 GMT) and issue a statement on his health some time after that.
A press office source told Reuters shortly before 6 p.m. that the office was working on a statement and that it would be published "soon".

The 65-year-old president was taken into the elite Central Clinical Hospital last Wednesday, just a fortnight after returning to work at the Kremlin following his heart bypass operation on November 5.
His absence has sparked calls from his opponents to step down but there is little likelihood of him being forced out of office.
